story.vex: Send it. We're listening on every channel you have. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. The intercepted copy shows nothing but stars. Astro: "Rivet, that's how you send data through hostile space: strip what doesn't need to travel."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Rivet must send the crew list to our Codexia allies, but Doom is listening on the channel. Mask the crew IDs and access codes before it goes out.

1. type crew-export.csv
2. mask crew-export.csv
3. Confirm crew-export.masked.csv has no raw ID numbers left

steps.title: Rivet's Workbench: mask before you send
steps.body: Rivet: "Doom is listening on this channel. What they can't read, they can't use." Read `crew-export.csv` first, so you see exactly what's at risk, then run `mask crew-export.csv`. It writes a redacted copy, `crew-export.masked.csv`.

objectives.label: crew-export.masked.csv has no raw ID or access-code numbers left
